title: Ukraine Crisis Map
description: Interactive strike & displacement map built for a humanitarian mapathon — Best Design, 2nd of 50+ teams.

title: Multilingual News Divergence Agent
description: AI agent that cross-references multilingual news coverage of the same event to surface factual divergence — Google Cloud Rapid Agent Hackathon (Elastic track), 14,000+ participants.

title: Vera Credential Registry
description: Blockchain credential registry — DSC180A/B capstone. 9 contracts, 77 tests passing, deployed to Polygon Amoy.

title: Deliberation & Vote-Buying Replication
description: Solo replication and extension of Wantchekon & Guardado (2024, APSR) on deliberation and vote-buying in a Beninese election.

title: AI Baseball Agent
description: Discrete HMM (EM-trained) + Viterbi decoding for pitch-sequence prediction, plus an RL batting agent — 80% next-pitch accuracy on a season (~3,000 pitches). 5-person team project (UCSD CSE 150A), contributor.

title: UCSD Parking Occupancy Analysis
description: Statistical analysis of UCSD parking occupancy by permit type (F = 25.52, p < 0.001); findings presented to UCSD Transportation Services.

title: Stress & Academic Performance Analysis
description: Interactive visualization of physiological stress vs. exam performance — HDSI data-storytelling competition, 50+ teams.

title: Triton2GO Wait-Time Prediction
description: ML-based wait-time prediction for UCSD's campus dining order app, integrated into the existing data pipeline. 4-person team.

title: N-Gram Language Model
description: An N-Gram language model implemented from scratch to generate and predict text sequences, trained on a Project Gutenberg corpus.

title: Boston Bike Lane Usage
description: Interactive visualization of bike lane usage rates across Boston using city data.

title: Persuasive & Deceptive Climate Visualizations
description: Examines how honest or deceptive visualization choices (filtering, scaling, annotation) can shape perception of climate data.

title: Loan Application EDA
description: Exploratory analysis of approved LendingClub loan applications — how borrower characteristics relate to loan terms and risk.
